gloss: to separate; to release; to let go of

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {離|はな}していませんでした

definitions.gloss: to separate; to keep apart; to set apart
definitions.explanation: To create distance between two things or move something away from something else.

definitions.gloss: to release; to let go of
definitions.explanation: To release one's grip or hold on something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{離|はな}して⟦{座|すわ}って→座る：00757_suwaru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please sit with your seats spaced apart.

examples.japanese: ⟦{喧嘩|けんか}→喧嘩：02996_kenka⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{離|はな}す⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧だった。
examples.english: It was difficult to pull the fighting dogs apart.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とき、⟦カンニング→カンニング：19419_kanningu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{机|つくえ}→机：00762_tsukue⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧⟦メートル→メートル：02975_meetoru⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧{離|はな}して⟦{並|なら}べた→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧。
examples.english: During the exam, the desks were spaced one meter apart to prevent cheating.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{離|はな}さないで⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please don't take your eyes off the children.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手綱|たづな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{離|はな}したら、⟦{走|はし}って→走る：00519_hashiru⟧⟦{行|い}って→行く：00119_iku⟧しまった。
examples.english: When I let go of the dog's leash, it ran off.

examples.japanese: {人混|ひとご}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{離|はな}さないようにして⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please make sure not to let go of your child's hand in a crowd.

notes:
{離|はな}す describes the physical action of moving things apart or letting go of something held. It covers both creating distance between objects and releasing one's grip.

INTRANSITIVE PAIR:
- {離|はな}す (transitive) — to separate/release something
- ⟦{離|はな}れる→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧ (intransitive) — to become separated; to leave

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{離|はな}す — to take one's eyes off (often used with negatives: ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{離|はな}さない)
- ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{離|はな}す — to let go (of something held in hand)
- {引|ひ}き{離|はな}す — to pull apart; to separate by force

CONTRAST WITH {話|はな}す:
- {離|はな}す — to separate; to release
- ⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧ — to speak; to talk
- Both are read はなす but have completely different meanings
